summary: Completed comprehensive testing of In-App Notifications (MVP), LOI Detailed View, and Email Scaffolding - Iteration 8. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified: NotificationBell shows for sellers (not buyers), notification panel opens with event list, mark as read functionality, LOI detailed view with financial details and Data Room activity metrics, signal strength badges.

backend: GET /api/notifications - returns notification list for authenticated user
NDA signing creates NDA_SIGNED notification for seller
Interest submission creates INTEREST_SUBMITTED notification for seller
LOI submission creates LOI_SUBMITTED notification for seller
Document download creates DOCUMENT_DOWNLOADED notification for seller
First data room access creates DATA_ROOM_ACCESSED notification for seller
Notifications have group_count field for grouping within 60s window
Buyer can call notifications API (returns empty - no seller notifications)
Email service logs placeholder when SENDGRID_API_KEY is empty (no crash)
frontend: NotificationBell component visible for sellers in header
NotificationBell NOT visible for buyers (correct role-based hiding)
Clicking bell opens notification panel with event list
Notification panel shows 'Marcar todo leído' button when unread notifications exist
Mark all read button works - unread count becomes 0
LOIs tab exists in DealManagement page
LOI cards show financial details (Valoración, Estructura, % Adquisición, Operación, Condiciones, Vinculante)
LOI cards show Data Room activity metrics (Descargas, Visualizaciones, Carpetas accedidas, Último acceso)
Signal strength badges appear (Sin actividad / Señal baja / Señal media / Señal alta)
Pending interests section shows below LOI cards
Notification events display correctly: NDA firmado, accedió al Data Room, descargó documento
